simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יְהוּדִי (H3065) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יְהוּדִי (Yᵉhûwdîy) means Jehudi , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Jer 36 14.

definitions.full: H3065. Yehudi II. יְהוּדִי proper name, masculine officer of Jehoiakim Jer 36:14 , 21 (twice in verse); 36:23 , ᵐ5 Ioudin (perhaps original appellation Jewish , of one not so by ancestry, see Gf Gie).
